The program error is a false trigger: the checker flags the word "input", which appears in two comments. I removed it. I also lowered the PMOS-reference branch current to recover some power budget. Power is tight: about 1 mS of gm is needed for 270 MHz into 0.5 pF, and at gm/Id near 10 that costs roughly 100 µA.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gm1":  (1.1e-3, 0.9e-3, 1.4e-3),    # amplifying-device gm target [S]
    "L1":   (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),             # amplifying NMOS L
    "Lp":   (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),             # PMOS load L (sets gds2)
    "gmp":  (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),           # PMOS load gm/Id
    "Ib2":  (3e-6, 2e-6, 8e-6),          # PMOS-reference branch current
    "Ln":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),             # NMOS mirror L
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vg = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    vo = 0.9

    # Amplifying device: Vgs fixed by the gate DC level; scale W to reach the gm target.
    L1 = p["L1"]
    r0 = lut.op("n", 10.0, L1, vg, vo)
    W1 = 10.0 * p["gm1"] / r0["gm"]
    W1 = min(max(W1, 0.42), 5000.0)
    r1 = lut.op("n", W1, L1, vg, vo)
    I1 = r1["Id"]
    gm1, gds1 = r1["gm"], r1["gds"]
    m1cap = lut.size("n", r1["gm_id"], L1, I1, vds=vo)   # parasitic estimates only

    # PMOS load carries I1 at vout = 0.9 V.
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=vdd - vo)
    # PMOS reference diode: same gm/Id and L.
    mpr = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], p["Ib2"], vds=m2.vgs)

    # NMOS mirror: ibias diode -> sink of Ib2 for the PMOS diode.
    mnr = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.65)
    mnr = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Ln"], iref, vds=mnr.vgs)
    mn3 = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Ln"], p["Ib2"], vds=vdd - mpr.vgs)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W1, L1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.dev("MPR", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpr)
    n.dev("MN3", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn3)
    n.dev("MNR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnr)

    # First-order performance predictions
    gds_t = gds1 + m2.gds
    A = gm1 / gds_t
    Ctot = cl + m1cap.cdd + m2.cdd + m1cap.cgd
    f3db = gds_t / (2 * PI * Ctot)
    gbw = A * f3db
    power = vdd * (I1 + p["Ib2"] + iref)
    swing = (vdd - m2.vdsat - 0.05) - (0.25)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "f3db": f3db, "gbw": gbw,
               "power": power, "vout_dc": vo, "swing": swing}
```
